use nexo.web

pub component Card(heading: str):
    view:
        article(class: "card"):
            h2(heading)
            slot()

    style:
        @import "./card.css";

pub component Counter(label: str, start: int = 0):
    state count: int = start

    fn increment():
        count += 1

    view:
        section:
            p("{label}: {count}")
            button("Local +", on_click: increment)

examples.scope: Experimental Python browser compiler M2; all project files required. Compilation evidence is separate from mandatory real-browser tests.
examples.source:
use nexo.web
use session
use ui.widgets

pub layout Shell:
    provide session.Visits
    visits = inject(session.Visits)
    state opens: int = 0

    fn open():
        opens += 1

    view:
        header:
            h1("Nexo Web M2")
            p("Shared visits: {visits.count}; layout clicks: {opens}")
            button("Layout +", on_click: open)
            nav:
                a("Home", href: "/")
                a("User 7", href: "/users/7")
        slot()

pub layout Details:
    layout = Shell
    state opens: int = 0

    fn open():
        opens += 1

    view:
        section:
            h2("Persistent nested layout")
            p("Nested layout clicks: {opens}")
            button("Nested +", on_click: open)
            slot()

pub page Home:
    path = "/"
    layout = Shell
    title = "Nexo Web — Home"
    description = "A compiled Nexo component, layout and context example."
    visits = inject(session.Visits)
    state label: str = "Local count"

    fn rename():
        label = "Updated count"

    view:
        main:
            widgets.Card(heading: label):
                p("Shared in slot: {visits.count}")
                button("Shared +", on_click: visits.increment)
                button("Rename", on_click: rename)
                widgets.Counter(label: label)

pub page User(id: int):
    path = "/users/{id}"
    layout = Details
    title = "Nexo Web — User {id}"
    visits = inject(session.Visits)

    view:
        main:
            h2("User {id}")
            p("Shared on another page: {visits.count}")
            button("Shared +", on_click: visits.increment)

pub page NotFound:
    not_found = true
    layout = Shell
    title = "Nexo Web — Not found"

    view:
        main:
            h2("Page not found")
            a("Return home", href: "/")

pub page Failure:
    error = true
    title = "Nexo Web — Error"

    view:
        main:
            h2("Unable to render this page")

examples.purpose: Typed async GET, explicit CSRF-protected mutation, loading/error rendering, immutable snapshot lists and invalidation
examples.scope: Experimental Python browser M3. Build app.nexo then run examples/web/data/server.py --directory dist for a local API. Static public demo is read-only. Compilation does not establish browser execution.
examples.source:
use nexo.web

pub type Product:
    id: int
    name: str

pub type NewProduct:
    name: str

pub component App(endpoint: str = "/api/products", writable: bool = true):
    load products = api.get(
        endpoint,
        as: list[Product],
        timeout_ms: 5000,
        retries: 1,
        cache_ms: 1000
    )

    mutation create = api.post(
        endpoint,
        body: NewProduct(name: "Nexo handbook"),
        as: Product,
        invalidate: [products]
    )

    view:
        main:
            h1("Nexo Web — typed data")
            if products.loading:
                p("Loading...", role: "status")
            elif products.error != none:
                p("{products.error.kind}: {products.error.message}", role: "alert")
                button("Retry", on_click: products.reload)
            elif products.ready:
                ul:
                    for product in products.data:
                        li(product.name)
            button("Reload", on_click: products.reload)
            button("Cancel read", on_click: products.cancel)
            button("Create product", on_click: create.run, disabled: not writable or create.loading)
            if create.loading:
                p("Saving...", role: "status")
            elif create.error != none:
                p("{create.error.kind}: {create.error.message}", role: "alert")
            elif create.success:
                p("Created: {create.data.name}", role: "status")

    style:
        main { max-width: 48rem; margin: 2rem auto; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui; }
        button { margin: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem; }
        button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }
